quote: Ample Power worked alongside PMG Group to deliver our office fitout at 14 Banfield Street, Chermside. The project spanned three levels across approximately 7,200 sqm and more than 800 workstations. The team consistently demonstrated a professional, organised and solutions-focused approach. They communicated well, maintained a tidy site and were proactive in identifying practical improvements, including a more effective configuration for our communications room to fit a large UPS system in a limited space.
name: Adam Sarti
role: Head of Corporate Procurement and Facilities
